breakfast.name: Balaleet (Sweet Vermicelli with Eggs)
instructions: Fry vermicelli in oil until golden
Add water, sugar, saffron, cardamom, cook until soft
Add rose water
Make thin omelette with eggs
Serve vermicelli topped with folded omelette
breakfast.description: A sweet-savory breakfast of sugared vermicelli topped with egg omelette.

breakfast.name: Khameer (Spiced Bread)
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, spices
Add ghee and warm milk, knead until smooth
Rise 1 hour
Shape into rounds, top with sesame
Bake at 180°C 20 min
Serve with date syrup
breakfast.description: Soft spiced bread served with date syrup for breakfast.

breakfast.name: Regag (Thin Crispy Bread)
instructions: Make very thin batter
Pour on hot dome griddle (tawa), spread paper-thin with hand
Cook 30 seconds until crispy
Crack egg on top if desired
Fold and serve with cheese or honey
breakfast.description: Paper-thin crispy bread cooked on a dome griddle — the ultimate Bahraini breakfast. The skill is spreading it impossibly thin.

breakfast.name: Balaleet (Sweet Vermicelli with Egg)
instructions: Lightly toast dry vermicelli in ghee until golden
Add water, sugar, saffron-rosewater, and cardamom
Cook until vermicelli absorbs liquid and is sweet and fragrant
Meanwhile, make a thin egg omelette with turmeric and salt
Place sweet vermicelli on plate, drape omelette on top
The sweet-savory combo — caramelized noodles under a savory egg — is the hook that went viral
breakfast.description: Sweet saffron vermicelli topped with a savory egg omelette — the Gulf breakfast that confuses and then converts everyone. The sweet-savory contrast went viral on food channels exploring Bahraini breakfast culture.

lunch.name: Machboos (Spiced Rice with Chicken)
instructions: Brown chicken pieces, set aside
Fry onions, add tomatoes, spices, dried limes
Return chicken, add water, simmer 20 min
Remove chicken, add rice to broth
Cook until rice absorbs liquid
Layer chicken on top, steam 10 min
Sprinkle with rose water
lunch.description: Bahrain's national dish — aromatic spiced rice with chicken.

lunch.name: Muhammar (Sweet Rice)
instructions: Cook rice until almost done
Drain, mix with date syrup and ghee
Add cardamom and saffron
Steam on low heat 15 min
Drizzle with rose water
Serve with grilled fish
lunch.description: Sweet rice cooked with date syrup and saffron, served with fish.

lunch.name: Thareed (Bread Stew)
instructions: Brown lamb, sauté onion and garlic
Add tomatoes, baharat, vegetables, and water
Simmer 30 min until lamb and vegetables are tender
Tear regag bread into large bowl
Ladle stew over bread — the bread soaks up the broth
Let sit 5 min before serving
lunch.description: Lamb stew poured over torn bread — the bread absorbs the rich broth. A beloved Ramadan dish in Bahrain.

dinner.name: Samak Mashwi (Grilled Hammour)
instructions: Mix spices with garlic, lime juice, oil
Marinate fish 30 min
Grill over medium-high heat 5 min per side
Garnish with cilantro and lime wedges
Serve with rice
dinner.description: Spice-rubbed grilled fish, a staple of Gulf cuisine.

dinner.name: Qoozi (Slow-Roasted Lamb)
instructions: Season lamb with baharat and salt
Roast at 160°C for 3 hours, covered
Cook rice with saffron and turmeric
Toast almonds and raisins in ghee
Shred lamb, serve over rice
Top with nuts and raisins
dinner.description: Slow-roasted lamb shredded over saffron rice — a feast dish.

dinner.name: Murabyan (Shrimp Rice)
instructions: Fry onions until very dark and crispy, set aside
Sauté shrimp heads and shells in ghee for flavor, strain
Cook rice in shrimp-flavored ghee with baharat, turmeric, dried lime
Layer cooked shrimp on rice halfway through cooking
Top with crispy fried onions and a splash of rosewater
Steam covered until done
dinner.description: Shrimp rice — Bahrain is a pearl-diving island, and seafood dominates the cuisine. The fried onions and rosewater finish are distinctly Gulf.

snacks.name: Sambousek (Fried Pastries)
ingredients: Dough: 2 cups flour, 2 tbsp oil, water, salt
Filling: 300g ground lamb, 1 onion, pine nuts, baharat
instructions: Make dough, rest 20 min
Cook filling: brown lamb with onion, add pine nuts and spices
Roll dough thin, cut circles
Fill, fold into half-moons, seal edges
Deep fry until golden
snacks.description: Crispy meat-filled pastries spiced with baharat.

snacks.name: Balaleet (Sweet Vermicelli, served cold)
instructions: Toast vermicelli in butter until golden
Add water, sugar, cardamom, saffron
Cook until tender and syrup is absorbed
Add rosewater
Serve warm or cold as a sweet snack
snacks.description: Sweet saffron vermicelli — also served for breakfast, but the cold version is a popular sweet snack.

desserts.name: Halwa Bahraini
instructions: Dissolve sugar in water, simmer to syrup
Mix cornstarch with water separately
Add cornstarch to syrup, stir constantly
Add ghee gradually, keep stirring
Add saffron, cardamom, rose water
Cook until translucent and pulls from sides
Pour into mold, top with nuts
desserts.description: A dense, translucent sweet scented with saffron and rose water.

desserts.name: Khabees (Toasted Flour Dessert)
ingredients: Sugar syrup (2 cups sugar, 1.5 cups water, saffron, rosewater, cardamom)
instructions: Toast flour in ghee, stirring constantly, until deep golden and fragrant
Make saffron sugar syrup
Pour syrup into toasted flour gradually, stirring
Cook until thick and pulls from the pan
Spread on plate, garnish with nuts
Cut into squares
desserts.description: Toasted flour sweet with saffron and rosewater — a traditional Bahraini dessert served during Ramadan and celebrations.

drinks.name: Karak Chai (Spiced Milk Tea)
instructions: Boil water with tea, cardamom, cinnamon, saffron
Simmer 5 min until deep amber
Add evaporated milk and sugar
Bring back to boil
Strain into glasses
drinks.description: Bahrain's beloved spiced milk tea — strong and sweet.

drinks.name: Jallab (Date and Grape Syrup Drink)
instructions: Mix jallab syrup with water
Add splash of rose water
Pour over ice
Top with pine nuts and raisins
drinks.description: A sweet, smoky date-grape syrup drink served ice cold.
